findings.message: ADTS cannot signal SBR or PS explicitly, but 6 of 6 raw data blocks hold SBR data: the stream is HE-AAC, signaled only implicitly, with an output rate of 44100 Hz. Decoders without SBR play the AAC LC core at 22050 Hz.
6 raw data blocks hold an SBR payload in a fill element with an extension payload of another type, which 4.5.2.1.5.2 does not allow; the first at 0x32.
